report.summary: Chunk 21/25 of daedalus/spine/picker.py: handles inventory source, eval_baseline, eval_gate, and hotspot source modes with candidate collection and notes.
risks: eval_gate handling | medium | 'include_eval' variable usage: when eval_gate_mode is 'enabled' but include_eval is False, the gate is disabled with a reason. This may be intended but could surprise users if they expect eval to run. | Check if include_eval is always set appropriately.
hotspot handling | medium | 'include_hotspots' variable usage: similar pattern to eval_gate, may be inconsistent if include_hotspots is not set. | Verify that include_hotspots is always defined.
inventory freshness | low | 'enforce_inventory_freshness' variable: if False, stale inventory is used; comment says 'FAIL CLOSED' but actually fails open in that case. | Confirm intended behavior.

handoff.purpose: Process inventory, eval_baseline, eval_gate, and hotspot source modes, collecting candidates and notes.

claims.text: FAIL CLOSED. Letting a snapshot of a different tree drive these bands means working from a repo that no longer exists.
claims.why: The code actually fails open: if enforce_inventory_freshness is False, candidates are added even when inventory is stale. The comment says FAIL CLOSED but the logic does the opposite.

claims.text: Regenerate INVENTORY_REL_PATH, or pass --stale-inventory to rank it anyway.
claims.why: INVENTORY_REL_PATH is not defined in this chunk; --stale-inventory is not referenced in code.
When baseline_mode is 'disabled', the reason string matches exactly.

claims.why: When baseline_mode is 'invalid', the error string matches.
